blocks.text: MANILA – Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial is likely to extend into December as the Senate prepares to accommodate both the defense’s presentation of evidence and deliberations on the proposed 2027 national budget, according to Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Tuesday.
